fusions.name: Trampling Heat
fusions.desc: Drives a wide wave of flame ahead of you that deals 12 damage to everything within 3.5 tiles, knocks each back 2.5 tiles and sets it [Burning] for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Warmth Passed Around
fusions.desc: A strike that deals 26 damage and sets the target [Burning] for 3 damage a second for 6 seconds. When it lands, every ally near you deals 20% more damage for 15 seconds.

fusions.name: Banked Hearth
fusions.desc: Banks a low fire where you stand. For 8 seconds it restores 3 health a second to you and any ally inside it.

fusions.name: Ember Calf
fusions.desc: Calls a bonded calf of fire that fights beside you, striking for 4 damage every 1.2 seconds and setting what it hits [Burning] for 2 damage a second for 3 seconds.
